joiner_mover_leaver.control: Provision least-privilege role from an approved template
Re-certify roles within 7 days of team change
Disable IdP + rotate service secrets within 24h

narrative: The application is designed as a secure example using Auth0 for GraphQL authentication (G-001, G-002). Best practices mandate that all requests require authentication for the entire GraphQL endpoint, and unauthenticated access must return a 401 (G-001). Currently, the existence of an unauthenticated-client (ID-002) exposed via the public HTTP surface indicates a high risk area that requires immediate validation against the secure authentication principles outlined in the source material (G-001). Privileged identities, specifically the privileged-operator (ID-004), are flagged for review, and their elevated access scope must be minimized to the principle of least privilege. The app-runtime service-account (ID-001) should also have its scope audited to ensure it only performs 'process-owner' functions necessary for its runtime context. All identities should be reviewed, especially those currently marked 'needs-review' (ID-003, ID-004), to confirm if they are properly restricted to the expected application sessions and roles.
priority_actions: Restrict unauthenticated-client (ID-002) access immediately to only necessary read endpoints, enforcing the 'Require authentication for the entire GraphQL endpoint' principle (G-001).
Review and restrict the scope of privileged-operator (ID-004) to ensure the 'privileged' role is only used when absolutely necessary.
Audit the service-account (ID-001) to limit 'process-owner' privileges to the minimum necessary for its runtime operations.
Confirm the authentication mechanism for human identities (ID-003, ID-004), ensuring MFA is enforced and that 'needs-review' statuses are remediated based on current organizational policy.
